summary.title: Design Principles
summary.one_liner: Design principles are clear statements that help teams make consistent decisions and trade-offs when designing products, services, or systems.
takeaways: Design principles are clear statements that guide consistent decisions and trade-offs.
They state what matters most and give teams a shared basis for decisions.
Organisations, individuals, and design system and product teams use them.
The page offers a curated set of featured examples and a free 5-email course on making better design decisions.
summary.summary: This page introduces design principles as decision-making frameworks for teams building products, services, or systems. It explains what they are, why teams use them (efficiency, consistency, user-centricity), and who writes them, including organisations, individuals, and design system and product teams. The rest of the page is a list of featured examples and recent articles, plus a sign-up prompt for a free 5-email course. The page text provides little detail beyond these introductory points.
